Version_comment: Runtime probe only. Reports which profiling APIs this release player actually implements - GC allocation counters, Unity's Profiler class, and the ProfilerRecorder counters - so the profiler proper can be designed against what exists rather than what the metadata advertises.
Title: Mod Profiler
Description: A development tool. Reports what profiling the game's Mono runtime exposes to a mod.
Author: Quinn Bast
